name: Manure
overview: Scripture illustrates the practical use of manure as a valuable fertilizer, as seen in Luke 13:8 where it is applied to cultivate growth. Isaiah 25:10 metaphorically compares the judgment of Moab to straw trodden down for the dunghill, highlighting the humbling process associated with manure. Luke 14:34-35 contrasts salt losing its savor with being unfit for both land and dunghill, emphasizing the importance of usefulness and purpose, including the role of manure in preparing the soil for fruitful growth.
